I had a very bad experience with Ladakh My Trip Travel Agent.

1. Overpriced flight ticket: I booked a Leh to Delhi flight for a friend for June 2026. They charged ₹12,000, which was ₹5,000 more than another travel agent right next to their office.
2. Ticket issues: At the airport, my friend was not allowed to board due to a PNR issue. We later found out it was a group ticket and the flight time had been changed, but the agent never informed us. No call, no update.
3. *Permit overcharging*: They charged ₹500 per person for ILP permits for my non-local friends. The actual cost is ₹400 if done directly online or through most agencies, since agents already get a commission from LAHDC.
4. Rude behaviour: The owner was extremely rude and acted like he’s the only travel agent in Ladakh.

Overall, highly dishonest and unprofessional. I strongly do NOT recommend this agency.
Rating: 1/10 (Wish I could give -10 stars)
